title_en: Supplementary Provisions (VI) of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Determination of Criminal Charges in the Execution of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
October 30, 2015
Supreme People's Court Supreme People's Procuratorate
Supplementary Provisions (VI) on Determining Crimes by Enforcing the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China
Fa Shi [2015] No. 20

According to the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law Amendment (IX) of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Criminal Law Amendment (IX)) and the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Revising Some Laws, the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Determining Crimes by Enforcing the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China and the Opinion of the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Crimes Applicable to the Specific Provisions of the Criminal Law are hereby supplemented and amended as follows:

These Provisions shall come into force as of November 1, 2015.
